# Appeal of Adverse Benefit Determination

**Member:** Riley Novak
**Member ID:** W755986580
**Plan:** Molina Healthcare (Commercial/ACA), Mississippi
**Reference number:** POC-1EC0B0CD1F-92337
**Date of denial notice:** 2026-08-10
**Procedure:** Total shoulder replacement, CPT 23472

**RE: Appeal of denial referenced above — request for reconsideration**

To Molina Healthcare Appeals Department,

I am appealing the denial of coverage for a total shoulder replacement (CPT 23472), which was denied on 2026-08-10 under reference number POC-1EC0B0CD1F-92337. My surgeon, Dr. Duval, has documented that this procedure is medically necessary for me, and I am asking Molina to reconsider this decision.

## Why I am appealing

The denial notice states that the reason for the determination is that "the imaging findings submitted do not support the medical necessity of the requested procedure." I do not believe this is accurate, and I am asking Molina to look again at what was actually submitted.

I want to be upfront that I have not been given the specific written criteria Molina used to evaluate my imaging or my case, so I am not able to quote Molina's policy language back in this letter. I am requesting that language below. What I can do is lay out, plainly, what my records show, so that Molina can compare that to whatever criteria were applied.

## What my records show

- **Symptom duration:** I have had 12 months of progressive shoulder pain that has not been relieved by rest.
- **Conservative treatment already completed:**
  - Supervised physical therapy focused on rotator cuff strengthening and scapular mechanics — 16 weeks, from 2026-03-06 to 2026-06-26, with 16 visits completed, documented in the physical therapy discharge note.
  - NSAIDs for 6 months with inadequate relief.
  - A corticosteroid injection on 2026-03-29 that gave only 4 weeks of partial relief.
- **Imaging:** An MRI of the shoulder on 2026-07-14 showed a full-thickness supraspinatus tear measuring 1.8 cm with grade 2 fatty atrophy.
- **Functional limitations:** I cannot lift my arm above shoulder height, and I cannot sleep on the affected side.
- **Exam findings:** Positive provocative testing on the affected side, with range of motion limited by pain.
- **No disqualifying factors:** No active infection, no untreated substance use, a BMI of 29, and I am a non-smoker.

My surgeon, Dr. Duval, an orthopedic surgeon, has reviewed this history and imaging and has documented that surgery is needed.

Because I have not been shown the specific imaging criteria Molina applied, I am not in a position to explain point-by-point why my MRI meets or does not meet that standard — only Molina can do that comparison, using the criteria it actually used. I am asking that this be done as part of the appeal review, using the full imaging report and clinical record described above.

## Request for the criteria used in my determination

I understand that Molina's own utilization-management materials state that the criteria used for review (MCG guidelines) are available behind the secure provider portal, and that members may call to obtain the criteria used to make a final determination. I am formally requesting, in writing, **the MCG guideline title and the specific criteria applied to my determination**, so that I and my surgeon can review them and, if needed, respond to them directly in this appeal.

## Deadline and where this appeal is being sent

I understand my appeal must be received by **2027-02-06** (180 days from the date of the denial notice, 2026-08-10). I am submitting this appeal through the Molina member portal at molinahealthcare.com and/or by mail to the appeal address printed on my denial letter, and I understand that the address on my denial letter is the authoritative one to use. I may also call the Member Services number on my Molina ID card with questions about this appeal.

## What I am asking for

1. That Molina reconsider and overturn the denial of total shoulder replacement (CPT 23472) for the reasons above.
2. That Molina provide, in writing, the MCG guideline title and criteria applied to my imaging review.
3. That Molina confirm receipt of this appeal and let me know if any additional records are needed.

Thank you for your time in reviewing this appeal. Please contact me if you need anything further from me or from Dr. Duval's office.

Sincerely,

_________________________
Riley Novak
Member ID: W755986580
Date: [insert date of signing]
Phone: [insert phone number]
Email: [insert email address]

---

*This letter is not medical or legal advice and does not guarantee that coverage will be approved.*
